projectDescription: An AI-powered web builder that guides non-technical users through a step-by-step process to create and deploy professional landing pages using Claude Code, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, and shadcn/ui — no coding required.
keyFeatures: Conversational questionnaire that gathers business details before writing a line of code
21 bundled professional skills covering design, motion, SEO, accessibility, and deployment
Automatic Vercel deployment — no account required, live URL in minutes
Anti-AI-slop design system: real typography, color theory, and motion rules to avoid generic-looking pages
Mobile-first responsive output built with Next.js 16, Tailwind CSS 4, and shadcn/ui
6-phase guided workflow from discovery through deploy with minimal user decisions
Design intelligence database with 161 color palettes and 57 font pairings
Bilingual support (English and Spanish) throughout the entire build flow
publicApiSurface: Phase 1: Discovery — 4-round questionnaire (questionnaire.md / questionnaire-es.md)
Phase 2: Design System — archetype selection from landing-page-patterns.md + ui-ux-pro-max
Phase 3: Scaffold — create-next-app + shadcn init + dependency installation
Phase 4: Build — layout.tsx, page.tsx, component generation with humanizer + animate skills
Phase 5: Preview & QA — playwright-cli screenshots, seo-audit, review-animations gate
Phase 6: Deploy — vercel-deploy/scripts/deploy.sh (sandbox, no account) or npx vercel --yes
